attrs.label: Secret Key
attrs.description:
A long random string that encrypts the AI service keys and SMTP/Resend credentials workspace owners save.</br>
Generate one with: `openssl rand -hex 32`</br>
Changing it later makes saved credentials unreadable, so owners must enter them again.

attrs.label: Public URL (Optional)
attrs.description:
Public URL of this instance (for example https://rowflare.example.com), used to build absolute links such as invites.</br>
Leave empty to derive links from the address used to open the app.

attrs.label: Allow Open Sign-Up
attrs.description:
When disabled, the first account created becomes the owner and everyone else joins by invite.</br>
When enabled, anyone who can reach the app can create an account.

attrs.label: Port Bind Mode
attrs.description:
The port bind mode.</br>
- Publish: The port will be published on the host for external access.</br>
- Expose: The port will be exposed for inter-container communication.</br>
- None: The port will not be exposed or published.</br>
Note: If the Dockerfile defines an EXPOSE directive,
the port will still be exposed for inter-container communication regardless of this setting.

1.0.0.readme:
Rowflare

Rowflare is an open-source Airtable alternative: grid, kanban, calendar, timeline, gallery and form views, Airtable-compatible formulas, automations, a REST API and an MCP server. Each base is its own SQLite database, and everything is stored in one data directory.
